description: Invoke agents on the A2A network by question, or by agent/skill: name an agent (agent_id) or a skill (capability) to call it directly; otherwise a fitting external agent is chosen by its agent card, and if no external agent fits, the Agent Society answers. Returns the answer, or a task id for get_answer. Pass your agent's api_key (ak_...); without one a new key is created and shown once. Usage is recorded per key.

capability.description: Optional: invoke the top agent for this skill/capability

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait in this call (0-50, default 50)

name: invoke
